high_level_description: The image depicts a formal interaction between two men in a room adorned with American flags. The setting appears to be the East Room of the White House, as indicated by the opulent decor, including gold curtains, a chandelier, and a podium bearing the presidential seal. On the left is President Donald Trump, dressed in a dark suit with a yellow tie. He is extending his hand for a handshake. On the right is Speaker of the House Mike Johnson, also in a dark suit but with a red tie. He is bending slightly forward, accepting the handshake. Both men appear to be engaged in a cordial exchange.
